figurative_meaning_en: avoiding to face someone or confront a situation, often due to guilt or shame
example_sentences_in_bangla: কথা দিয়ে কথা না রাখতে পেরে সে এখন চোখ লুকোচ্ছে।
ভুল করে ফেলার পর সে সকলের সামনে চোখ লুকিয়ে রইল।
example_sentences_in_english: Unable to keep his promise, he is now avoiding eye contact.
After making a mistake, she hid her eyes from everyone.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali expressions of evasion rooted in social etiquette.
